projects.title: zkpow
projects.description:
A validity proof system for Nakamoto consensus; currently using the SP1 RISC-V ZKVM. Enables API-based wallets that can't be forged and P2P SPV wallets without the major startup time. It also gives any chain that can verify groth16 SNARKS  or PLONKs the ability to understand Bitcoin's consensus state like any other node, allowing for trustless chain interoperability, e.g. for direct swaps.

Started in 2018 and have iterated on it every new generation of ZK tooling. It's gone from intractable, to extremely difficult, to workable but too slow, to being able to prove the all block header in less than a day.
